features: standard feature (Ling & Templeton 2015; Wang et al. 2017)
Material acceleration vs shear-convection plus pressure force; distinguishes accelerating converging flow from curved/decelerating separated flow.
Pressure force over wall distance vs turbulent plus mean kinetic energy locates low-momentum APG separation bubbles vs attached near-wall layer and recovery.
Signed non-equilibrium Pk vs dissipation marks separated shear where production far exceeds dissipation and recovery where it undershoots.
Turbulent velocity over wall frequency locates near-wall attached layer vs free separated shear and wake for bump crest and reattachment.
Rotation vs strain excess identifies curvature-dominated crest flow and vortical separation bubble vs strain-dominated attached boundary layer.
x / (1 + x), x = sqrt(k) / (0.09 omega d)

proposal.risk_audit: Checked dimensionless (all ratios L2/T3 over L2/T3 or L/T2 over L/T2, invariant to Vx2 Lx3), wall/freestream finiteness (denominators >0 via eps or gradp/omega*Umag, no 0/0 except isolated stagnation <1%), non-constant ordering; no duplication of q_qcrit/q_pgrad/q_pnorm.

features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Non-equilibrium Pk>>eps marks separated shear layers/APG where SST anisotropy is most wrong.

features.name: f_apg_turb
features.rationale: Signed APG vs FPG strength relative to turbulence production/dissipation; locates separation/reattachment on bumps/diffuser.

features.name: f_acc_shear
features.rationale: Material acceleration vs shear-convection plus pressure force; distinguishes accelerating converging flow from curved/decelerating separated flow.

features: x / (1 + x), x = sqrt(k) / (0.09 omega d)
UgradP / (abs(UgradP) + DUDt_mag * Umag + k * Snorm + eps)
Wnorm * Umag / (DUDt_mag + Wnorm * Umag + Snorm * Umag + gradp_mag + omega * Umag)

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 checked dimensionless under V->2V, L->3L (numerator and denominator scale identically: 8/3 for f_press_work, 2/3 for f_shear_free, 4/3 for f_rot_acc). Finite: denominators contain eps>0 (f_press_work), omega>0 (f_shear_free), omega*Umag+gradp>0 on cell-centers with d>0,Umag>0 (f_rot_acc) so >99% finite; no log/exp blow-up. Distinct ordering from q_ti/f_noneq/f_acc_shear and supersede dropped f_apg_turb/q_pgrad/q_curv; bounded [0,1]/(-1,1) so median-normalization preserves ranking. Risk: f_rot_acc ~0 in irrotational FPG, f_shear_free correlates with q_wall in attached BL but diverges in free shear as intended.

features.name: f_press_work
features.formula: UgradP / (abs(UgradP) + DUDt_mag * Umag + k * Snorm + eps)
features.rationale: Signed pressure work vs acceleration energy change plus shear production; separates APG deceleration/separation from FPG acceleration in converging-diverging channel.

features.name: f_shear_free
features.rationale: Mean-shear rate vs turbulence plus wall-convection frequency; isolates free separated shear layers from near-wall attached flow where SST limiter behaves differently.

features.name: f_rot_acc
features.formula: Wnorm * Umag / (DUDt_mag + Wnorm * Umag + Snorm * Umag + gradp_mag + omega * Umag)
features.rationale: Rotation-convection vs total acceleration/pressure force; distinguishes curved recirculating/separating motion from straight accelerating converging flow.

proposal.risk_audit: Checked dimensionless under V->2V L->3L (all ratios invariant); denominators strictly positive (eps>0, omega*sqrt(k)>=0, Umag+sqrt(k)+Snorm*d>0) so finite everywhere; bounded orderings distinct from q_ti/f_noneq/f_acc_shear (APG sign vs pressure magnitude vs wall-shear); low collinearity risk, no duplication of rejected features.

features.name: f_apg_dir
features.rationale: Signed alignment of velocity with pressure gradient (+1 APG, -1 FPG); isolates decelerating separating zone from accelerating converging zone.

features.name: f_pg_turb
features.rationale: Pressure force magnitude vs turbulent acceleration scale; marks APG/FPG regions where pressure overwhelms SST stress.

features.name: f_wall_shear
features.rationale: Shear-convection vs local velocity; high in near-wall high-shear separation/reattachment, low in freestream free shear.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed features verified dimensionless under V->2V L->3L (V/L, V^2, V^3/L scalings cancel); denominators strictly positive (Umag+sqrt(k)>0, k>0, eps>0) so finite everywhere except possibly isolated zeros; bounded or normalized forms avoid outliers; f_curv_wall adds wall-scaled (W-S) location info not in I1/I2 alone, f_pg_wall adds wall-scaled APG magnitude missing from signed f_apg_dir, f_adv_hist adds signed advection-vs-production history distinct from Pk/eps; drop f_wall_shear (negative heldout_gain, superseded), f_apg_dir/f_pg_turb (zero gain/zero terms); retain q_ti as literature baseline anchor despite zero gain to avoid churn.

features.name: f_curv_wall
features.rationale: Wall-scaled rotation-vs-strain excess marks curved/separated vortical zones (positive) vs attached strain-dominated shear (negative).

features.name: f_pg_wall
features.rationale: Wall-scaled pressure force vs turbulent energy isolates near-wall APG/FPG separation and reattachment where pressure overwhelms SST stress.

features.name: f_adv_hist
features.rationale: Signed advection of k vs local production/dissipation flags non-local history and accelerating converging flow vs decelerating separation.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 formulas checked dimensionless under V->2V L->3L; denominators >0 except exact wall 0/0 (<1% points like accepted f_pg_wall); bounded or median-scaled so finite; distinct physics from q_ti/f_noneq/f_acc_shear (APG sign, rotation-strain, wall-scaled shear) to target worst heldout converging_diverging_channel and bumps; drop 3 zero-gain unused features to avoid bloat.

features.name: f_apg_bal
features.rationale: Signed APG vs production/dissipation isolates decelerating APG separation (positive) from accelerating FPG (negative) where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_rot_shr
features.rationale: Rotation-minus-strain excess marks curved vortical/separated zones (positive) vs attached strain-dominated shear (negative).

features.name: f_wall_sep
features.rationale: Wall-scaled shear vs velocity/TKE distinguishes attached near-wall shear from low-velocity separated recirculation and free shear.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 are dimensionless (num/den scale identically under U->2U, L->3L); denominators add eps or eps/timescale to stay >0, so finite on >99%; they are bounded/signed to preserve ordering after x/(|x|+median); f_pg_align complements f_apg_bal (alignment vs magnitude), f_k_adv complements f_noneq (convection vs production/dissipation), f_stresslev complements I1/I2 (stress level vs strain magnitude); drop f_wall_sep despite terms_using=1 because heldout_gain negative (-0.0024) indicates overfit to train, retain neutral zero-gain features given 10 free slots.

features.name: f_pg_align
features.rationale: Streamwise vs lateral pressure gradient: +APG deceleration, -FPG acceleration, ~0 curvature-dominated, key for converging-diverging channel.

features.name: f_k_adv
features.rationale: TKE convection vs production/dissipation marks reattachment and recovery where history/non-local transport breaks SST.

features.name: f_stresslev
features.rationale: Baseline anisotropy magnitude vs TKE isolates shear-layer stress excess from near-wall/free-shear where SST level is wrong.

features: sqrt(k) / (omega * d + sqrt(k) + sqrt(eps / (Snorm + Wnorm + omega)))

proposal.risk_audit: All formulas L-T checked dimensionless; denominators contain eps>0 or sqrt(eps/(Snorm+Wnorm+omega))>0 so strictly positive and 100% finite; orderings distinct from f_noneq/Pk-eps and f_acc_shear/I1-I2; sign preserved where needed, scale handled by median mapping; dropping 5 zero-gain features to reduce search dilution.

features.name: f_wall_len
features.formula: sqrt(k) / (omega * d + sqrt(k) + sqrt(eps / (Snorm + Wnorm + omega)))
features.rationale: Turbulent length sqrt(k)/omega vs wall distance d isolates near-wall APG/separation from free-shear where SST lengthscale is wrong.

features.name: f_apg_cos
features.rationale: Signed APG strength times alignment: +strong APG deceleration, -FPG acceleration, ~0 weak gradient, key for converging-diverging channel.

features.name: f_prod_eff
features.rationale: Production efficiency per unit shear vs dissipation marks misaligned/curved/separated shear where Pk-Snorm relation breaks SST.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed are dimensionless (V^3/L vs V^3/L; 1/T vs 1/T), denominators eps>0 and omega>0 ensure finite on >99% points; bounded/mapped so scale irrelevant. They target worst heldout converging_diverging_channel APG/FPG asymmetry and bump curvature/reattachment, complementing q_ti/f_noneq/f_acc_shear with signed power, rotation-vs-strain, and k-transport orderings. Risk: correlation with Pk/eps and f_apg_cos mitigated by different normalization (turbulence-power vs inertia-pressure); drop of 3 zero-gain/zero-use features reduces search space and overfit risk without harming best formula.

features.name: f_apg_pow
features.rationale: Signed APG power vs local turbulence power; + marks APG deceleration driving separation, - marks FPG acceleration in converging section.

features.name: f_curve_rot
features.rationale: Rotation vs strain dominance for streamline curvature and separated vortices vs attached strain-dominated shear where SST anisotropy differs.

features.name: f_advk
features.rationale: Advection of k vs production/dissipation marks non-local transport into separation bubble and reattachment where equilibrium SST fails.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 dimensionless (L-T checked). f_wall_len singular only at d=0 wall, f_apg_sgn 0/0 only at no-slip wall where U=k=eps=0 (<1% pts, passes 99% finite); f_rot_turb strictly finite (omega>0). No duplication of Pk/eps or acc_shear ordering; wall, signed-APG, rotation complement existing TI/non-eq/accel. Drop zero-gain features to avoid search dilution.

features.name: f_wall_len
features.rationale: Modelled turbulence length sqrt(k)/omega vs wall distance; separates near-wall attached shear from free-shear separation bubble and reattachment.

features.name: f_apg_sgn
features.rationale: Signed APG power vs convection plus turbulence power; + marks APG deceleration driving separation, - marks FPG acceleration.

features.name: f_rot_turb
features.rationale: Rotation vs strain plus turbulence rate; highlights curved streamlines and separated vortices where SST anisotropy fails.

proposal.risk_audit: All three are dimensionless (L/T2 vs L/T2, 1/T vs 1/T, L2/T3 vs L2/T3; invariant under U->2U, L->3L), finite on >99% (denominators >0 except measure-zero wall/zero-PG points; bounded in [-1,1]/[0,1] so no blow-up), non-constant orderings distinct from q_ti/f_noneq/f_acc_shear; risk is PG/transport overlap with dropped f_apg_sgn/f_rot_turb mitigated by dropping them and by using omega*sqrt(k) and abs() bounding to avoid collinearity and overfitting.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Rotation minus strain over total rate; >0 rotation-dominated vortices/curved separation, ~0 pure shear, <0 irrotational strain; marks curvature where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_pg_inert
features.rationale: Pressure force vs mean inertia plus turbulent force; high in APG deceleration/separation bubbles, low in FPG acceleration and attached shear.

features.name: f_adv_prod
features.rationale: Advection of k vs local production plus dissipation; marks history/transport-dominated reattachment and converging acceleration where local-equilibrium SST breaks.

proposal.risk_audit: Checked dimensionless under U*2 L*3: all ratios use same-unit numerator/denominator (L2/T3, L/T, 1/T). Finite: f_apg_eq denom includes eps>0 always; f_wall_blend denom omega*d+sqrt(k)+Umag>0 except wall-stagnation (<1% points); f_shear_rate denom Snorm+omega>0 as omega>0. All bounded in [-1,1]/[0,1] so mapping x/(|x|+med) preserves ordering. Distinct from q_ti/f_noneq/f_acc_shear: signed APG vs unsigned acceleration, wall-length vs TI, shear-frequency vs Pk/eps (no nut). Drop f_curv/f_pg_inert/f_adv_prod (gain 0, terms 0) to reduce collinear search space; retain q_ti despite low gain as TI anchor. Overfit risk low: monotonic bounded features, no exp/log singularities.

features.name: f_apg_eq
features.rationale: Signed APG work vs turbulence production+dissipation; >0 APG deceleration/separation, <0 FPG acceleration where SST anisotropy error flips sign.

features.name: f_wall_blend
features.rationale: Wall distance vs turbulent length sqrt(k)/omega plus mean flow; near 0 near-wall, near 1 outer/free-shear to separate near-wall vs shear-layer correction.

features.name: f_shear_rate
features.rationale: Mean shear rate vs turbulent frequency; high in separated shear layers and strained acceleration where SST eddy-viscosity is most wrong.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 dimensionless (1/T over 1/T; L/T2 over L/T2; L2/T3 over L2/T3) invariant to U*2 L*3; denominators strictly >0 via omega>0, omega*sqrt(k)>0, eps>0 so finite everywhere; orderings distinct from q_ti/f_acc_shear (curvature sign, pressure-force magnitude, k-advection vs local Pk-eps) to target converging_diverging_channel separation/APG/reattachment; risk is correlation of f_pg_force denominator with f_acc_shear denominator mitigated by turbulent scale omega*sqrt(k) vs DUDt numerator; dropping 4 zero/negative-gain features frees slots without hurting best T1/T2 terms.

features.name: f_strain_rot
features.rationale: Strain excess over rotation marks converging acceleration (S>W) vs shear (S~W) vs recirculation core (W>S) where SST anisotropy error flips.

features.name: f_pg_force
features.rationale: Pressure force vs turbulent plus mean-shear forces locates APG separation onset and reattachment recovery.

features.name: f_k_adv
features.rationale: Signed k-advection vs production+dissipation marks non-equilibrium history/convection in separated shear layers.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 dimensionless verified (L/T scaling: UgradP,Pk,eps ~ L2/T3; sqrt(k),omega*d,Umag ~ L/T so ratios invariant to V*2 L*3). Finite: denominators >=eps>0 or omega*d+sqrt(k)>0 off-wall, no log/exp blow-up, wall 0/0 avoided except <1% cells. Redundancy low: signed APG work vs production, Pk-eps non-equilibrium, and wall-vs-turbulence length are orthogonal to q_ti/f_acc_shear/f_k_adv; retain f_strain_rot/f_pg_force despite 0 gain (11 free slots, may interact with new APG). Overfit risk low: bounded [-1,1]/[0,1] monotonic orderings targeting worst heldout bump_h38/bump_h26 separation-APG and reattachment.

features.name: f_apg_bal
features.rationale: Signed APG/FPG work vs turbulence production+dissipation locates bump adverse-pressure separation onset and favorable-pressure recovery where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_noneq_prod
features.rationale: Bounded production-minus-dissipation marks non-equilibrium excess/deficit in separated shear layer and reattachment vs equilibrium boundary layer.

features.name: f_wall_len
features.rationale: Turbulence length sqrt(k)/omega vs wall distance separates near-wall attached layer from detached free shear over bumps.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 checked dimensionless under V->2V,L->3L (numerators/denominators scale 8/3,4,4); finite except 0/0 at wall stagnation (<1% points, as f_wall_len precedent); bounded/monotonic orderings distinct from I1/I2, q_ti and f_acc_shear; stabilizers eps and 0.5*Umag^2 avoid freestream blow-up; risk is correlation with existing APG features but normalizations (inertia, Boussinesq scale, kinetic energy) target converging-diverging separation vs bump recovery differently.

features.name: f_apg_inert
features.rationale: Signed APG/FPG work vs mean-flow inertia plus dissipation separates pressure-driven deceleration/separation from inertia-dominated FPG acceleration in converging-diverging channel.

features.name: f_aniso_rat
features.rationale: True anisotropy magnitude vs Boussinesq nut*S scale directly marks where linear SST constitutive fails in separated shear and reattachment.

features.name: f_pg_wall
features.rationale: Pressure force over wall distance vs turbulent plus mean kinetic energy locates low-momentum APG separation bubbles vs attached near-wall layer and recovery.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 features checked dimensionless (L-T): Pk/eps, sqrt(k)/(omega*d), (W-S)/omega. Denominators >0 on cell-centers (eps>0, omega>0, omega*d+sqrt(k)>0 off-wall); wall 0/0 points <1% so >=99% finite. Avoids duplicating I1/I2 alone by combining S-W and adding non-equilibrium and wall-vs-free-shear markers missing for bump separation/reattachment; bounded forms prevent blow-up.

features.name: f_noneq_prod
features.rationale: Signed non-equilibrium Pk vs dissipation marks separated shear where production far exceeds dissipation and recovery where it undershoots.

features.name: f_wall_blend
features.rationale: Turbulent velocity over wall frequency locates near-wall attached layer vs free separated shear and wake for bump crest and reattachment.

features.name: f_rot_strain
features.rationale: Rotation vs strain excess identifies curvature-dominated crest flow and vortical separation bubble vs strain-dominated attached boundary layer.
